lines: Bondrail lets onchain businesses issue revenue bonds. For a business using paid APIs, investors need a way to check that covered payments still point to the agreed revenue account.

This is the live payment offer from our test API. The payment destination matches the account committed in the bond's watch policy. Chainlink C R E checks this external condition and carries the result onchain.
Here we run the actual C R E command line simulation with broadcast enabled.
The workflow retrieves a signed observation and independently fetches the manifest and payment offers. It checks agreement, signature and freshness before creating a report.
The simulation then submits that report to the covenant contract on Monad testnet.
The transaction succeeded. This receipt comes directly from Monad R P C. The covenant emitted Observation Accepted, with result one: compliant.
A fresh compliant report is required to activate a Watched bond. Two confirmed violations in adjacent observation epochs can trigger its default path.
This demonstrates a successful C R E simulation and a real testnet report. It is not a production C R E deployment. The testnet configuration retains a trusted observer signer.
